question: Use a straightedge and compass to construct the bisector \(OP\) of \(\angle AOB\) (\(OC=OD\), \(CP=DP\), and \(P\) lies inside the angle). If \(\angle AOB=70^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle AOP\) in degrees.
solution: Since \(OP\) is the stated bisector of \(\angle AOB\), it divides the angle into two equal parts. Therefore \(\angle AOP=70^\circ\div2=35^\circ\).

reference.question: Use a straightedge and compass to construct the bisector \(OP\) of \(\angle AOB\) (\(OC=OD\), \(CP=DP\), and \(P\) lies inside the angle). If \(\angle AOB=70^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle AOP\) in degrees.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use the stated angle bisector

Since \(OP\) is the stated bisector of \(\angle AOB\), it divides the angle into two equal parts. Therefore \(\angle AOP=70^\circ\div2=35^\circ\).
